evidence: Independent placement method fitted only on 273 worker-0 passes reduces the slowest rank's M128 tile work by 21.49-21.58% in all 1367 held-out passes.

Exact imported production map reduces critical-rank tile work by 21.54-21.62% on the recorded workload. Those production-map counts are in-sample, separately labelled from the holdout method experiment.

Serving Prefill MoE 2.17 ms/layer versus balanced gate 1.66 ms is consistent with the measured rank imbalance. Approximately 63.5% of Prefill forward GPU time is MoE; full translation gives about 13.6% forward-time reduction. This is a model, not a measured end-to-end gain.

128-row Decode dispatch counter atomics fall from 16896 to at most 1024 (813 in the deterministic random screen). Combine active CTAs rise 16 to 128 without increasing bytes or changing numerical order. These operation counts are not timing measurements.

Independent kernel benchmark 39053820377 adds a useful limit: instrumented Decode send-count atomics take about 1.15 us and active combine about 8.49 us; only about 3.99 us remains after overlapping dispatch cleanup. The timeline adds 16% whole-call overhead. Communication reduction alone does not justify >7000; placement's actual serving result remains necessary.

External 1x1 run 39060930640 has 20 SHA-256-verified archive files and bitwise agreement on all 12 cases. Decode-128 median 203.200 us, p10 201.696 us, p90 204.480 us. The 2x1 and 1x2 archives also have 20 verified files and matching numerical hashes; both are slower.
confidence_gate.remaining: The 1x1 winner is measured independently, but the combined communication/fusion image still requires fresh CPU build and image verification. Recompute the whole-cycle/SLA projection without double-counting removed kernels before the one final Firmus allocation.
confidence_gate.uncertainty: Kernel work reduction does not by itself bound goodput: synchronization, Decode capacity, EAGLE acceptance, TTFT/ITL tails and finite-run variation still matter. No 7000 result is claimed before the official workload runs.
